name: Freeman General Contracting
summary: A North Georgia builder of hospitality and commercial places. Website, identity, film, case studies and the words the company uses to describe itself.
description: Freeman General Contracting and Tangerine: the freemangc.com website, the Freeman signature and eagle, brand films, case-study systems and public messaging. An ongoing creative relationship.
intro: Freeman General Contracting builds hospitality and commercial places across North Georgia. Built for Generations.
The relationship began with an eagle and has grown into the company's website, signature, colorways, films, case studies and public language: one body of work, still being added to.
ogAlt: The Freeman General Contracting homepage: a red script signature on sand

chapters.title: freemangc.com
chapters.note: Design and development of the company website. Project photography on the site is by Jared Swafford and Freeman General Contracting and appears here only as part of the site.

artifacts.title: freemangc.com, home
artifacts.alt: The Freeman homepage in its sand colorway: a red pixel script signature reading Freeman centered above a small navigation line
artifacts.note: One screen, no scroll. The signature writes itself on arrival, then the four rooms of the site: Company, Projects, Photographs, Contact. [freemangc.com](https://www.freemangc.com/)

artifacts.title: Light colorway
artifacts.alt: The Freeman homepage on white with the signature in dark umber
artifacts.note: Three colorways, chosen by the visitor: white, sand and umber.

artifacts.title: Dark colorway
artifacts.alt: The Freeman homepage on dark umber with the signature in cream
artifacts.note: Freeman red is kept for the current place and the things that matter.

artifacts.title: *Places we've built*
artifacts.alt: A full-screen line map of North Georgia with Freeman projects marked in red and a project register down the right side
artifacts.note: Projects as a map of North Georgia: every mark opens its project, and the register on the right lists all of them.

artifacts.title: Project page, *Beetlecat*
artifacts.alt: A Freeman project page for Beetlecat in Atlanta: a photograph of a red-and-plaid restaurant bar beside a narrow column of project credits
artifacts.note: Each project as a quiet plate: one photograph, its credits, nothing else. Photograph by Jared Swafford.

artifacts.title: Home, on a phone
artifacts.alt: The Freeman homepage on a phone: the red signature on sand with the navigation stacked beneath

artifacts.title: The map, on a phone
artifacts.alt: The Freeman project map on a phone with zoom controls and a project search field
artifacts.note: The same composure at phone size; nothing is cut down into a lesser version.

chapters.title: Identity
chapters.note: A signature, a stamp and an eagle, each drawn to work at every size from a favicon to a jobsite sign.

artifacts.title: The Freeman signature
artifacts.alt: The Freeman pixel script signature in red on sand, drawn from a 160 by 61 bitmap
artifacts.note: A script signature drawn as a 160 × 61 bitmap, so it can write itself on screen and stay exact at any size.

artifacts.title: The stamp eagle
artifacts.alt: A bitmap spread eagle in Freeman red on sand, like an ink stamp
artifacts.note: The eagle as an ink stamp, used where Freeman signs off: the contact page, approvals, the end of a film.

artifacts.title: The eagle
artifacts.alt: A line drawing of a spread eagle with an F monogram on its chest, in Freeman red
artifacts.note: Where the relationship started: a spread eagle carrying the F.

artifacts.title: Brand system 001
artifacts.alt: A brand system study sheet: the Freeman script, the eagle, the tagline Built for Generations and a row of colour swatches
artifacts.note: Three directions, each tested across the same six everyday uses, from business cards to a jobsite sign.

artifacts.title: Jobsite sign, *Little Rey*
artifacts.alt: A jobsite sign study: LITTLE REY in heavy black letters beside a red panel with a white eagle and Freeman contact details
artifacts.note: The system on a fence line: project, place, type and status, with the eagle in a field of Freeman red.

artifacts.title: *Built for Generations*, brand film 003
artifacts.alt: A vertical film: the Freeman signature writes itself, the colorways change, the map opens on Beetlecat, the eagle stamps and the lockup reads Built for Generations
artifacts.note: Twelve seconds, vertical, for Reels and Stories: signature, colorways, the map, one photograph opening to full frame, the stamp, the lockup. Built from footage of the live site. Photograph by Jared Swafford. Shown here without sound.

artifacts.title: *What's happening at Freeman?*, concept film
artifacts.alt: A concept film of a quiet question-and-answer interface for Freeman, ending on a red APPROVED eagle stamp
artifacts.note: Thirty seconds on how a builder might ask its own record a question. The interface and its data are illustrative.

chapters.title: Case studies and editorial
chapters.note: Systems for telling the story of a building, and of the company.

artifacts.title: The Built Record, *Muchacho Decatur*
artifacts.alt: A case-study page: a line-drawn front elevation of a 1940 house turned restaurant, split down the middle with a photograph of the real porch
artifacts.note: A case-study system for architectural work: record drawings traced from photographs, set against the finished building, with only what is known about the project.

artifacts.title: *Built for Generations*, conversations
artifacts.alt: An editorial index titled Built for Generations listing a series of conversations, set in monospace on paper
artifacts.note: An editorial series of conversations, built around the tagline. Content shown is example only.

chapters.title: Words
chapters.note: Public language, as it reads on freemangc.com.

artifacts.title: Company philosophy
artifacts.text: Good construction is a relationship, not a transaction.
